parsed.reason: Every fact checks out against the notes: third-party testing, the underdosed ingredients, no independent clinical evidence, and about $89 a month on subscription or $112 one-time. It gives a real pick ('mostly overrated') in a casual tone. But the notes flag real health cautions: upper-limit concerns if you double up on vitamin A, zinc or niacin, and reishi and grape seed interacting with blood thinners and blood pressure medication. watchFor asks for the caution a friend would add about a health product, and the answer leaves this out entirely.
